params.name: q
params.description: Search query that matches against the username, name, or short_description fields.

params.name: provider
params.description: Filter results to boxes supporting a specific provider such as virtualbox or vmware_desktop.

params.name: sort
params.description: The field to sort results on.

params.name: order
params.description: The order to return the sorted field in.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of results to return per page, with a maximum of 100.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to return for paginated results.

items.docs: Searches the public Vagrant box catalog. The search query matches against the username, name, or short_description fields. If the query is omitted, the top boxes based on sort and order are returned.
